Goliath's spear, described with extraordinary measurements (1 Sam 17:7), symbolizes Philistine power. The prophetic vision of beating spears into pruning hooks (Isa 2:4; Mic 4:3) draws its power from the familiarity of this weapon. Spanish lanza, French lance, and German Speer render it uniformly."
